title: What it is, in a phrase a reader can scan

source.title: The paper or documentation this comes from

author: your name
appliesWhen: The conditions that make this worth doing. This field does the work — an agent decides applicability from it.
doesNotApplyWhen: When to leave it alone. Usually more useful than the field above.
claim: What improves, and roughly by how much.
adoptionCost: Honestly, including the parts that are not code: re-indexing, dual-running, review time.
learned: What you found implementing it — the precondition that turned out to matter, the failure mode you hit. This is the half a model cannot supply.
detect: How to tell whether a codebase already does this.
